messages:
maria: Heads up 1 - migrating sample-embedder to SDK v2 broke nightly job. REST batch embed request with newline-delimited JSON worked, SDK call returns 400 for same payload.

tim: was this the ndjson endpoint? REST supports both `application/json` (array) and `application/x-ndjson` with \n-separated docs for large batches. SDK's embeddings.batch() always serializes to JSON array.

maria: yep, sampleapp streams huge text sets and used ndjson to reduce mem. curl still works:

```
# REST (works)
cat bigfile.ndjson | curl -X POST 
  -H "Content-Type: application/x-ndjson" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" 
  --data-binary @- https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/batch
```

# SDK (fails)
```js
await client.embeddings.batch({ model: 'rwd-embed-1', inputs: streamFromFile('bigfile.ndjson') })
// throws 400 Bad Request: unexpected token at position 0
```

anya: interesting. SDK's helper expects an in-memory array or an async iterable of JSON objects, but not raw ndjson bytes. We probably don't parse content-type for streaming uploads.

maria: error message was confusing for users 1 - they think model mismatched. Ticket from infra: support got 3 reports overnight.

tim: options: 1) accept raw ndjson streams in SDK and translate to server-compatible multipart/stream; 2) update docs and sampleapp to show how to convert ndjson->async iterable; 3) add an opt-in `allowNdjsonStream` flag to embeddings.batch for backwards compat.

anya: I vote #1 + #3 (parity + opt-in). Implementing #1 is small but needs attention to backpressure and boundaries. Also adjust Content-Type header to application/x-ndjson when input is a stream of lines.

ci-bot: build 4821 failed on preview: `embeddings_integration_test` (flaky) - see logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/4821 (retry recommended)

maria: can someone own the docs change? I'll handle the SDK patch if we agree on API. Need to avoid large memory copies.

tim: I'll open a design issue with proposed API and work through client impl + tests. PR template: include examples for Node stream + Python generator.

anya: small snippet for conversion if we don't change SDK right away:
```js
// turn ndjson file into async iterable of objects
async function* ndjsonToObjects(stream) {
  for await (const line of stream) {
    if (!line.trim()) continue
    yield JSON.parse(line)
  }
}
await client.embeddings.batch({ model: 'rwd-embed-1', inputs: ndjsonToObjects(fs.createReadStream('bigfile.ndjson')) })
```

maria: good short-term fix. I'll add that to the sampleapp README and mention perf caveats. Then we'll decide on opt-in flag in SDK.

tim: filing GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/436 - design doc linked there.

anya: also add an error text improvement so SDK surfaces something like: `Expected JSON array or async iterable; received raw ndjson bytes. See docs for streaming examples.` That should cut down on tickets.

ci-bot: Issue created: #436 by tim (labels: sdk, embeddings, parity)

maria: thanks all. assigning follow-ups in the ticket. :raised_hands:
